reviews.reason: In s0310 the chapter says 元帝初鎮江東 and then summons Ren Xu as staff. That 元帝 is the Eastern Jin founder settling Jiangdong, not a later Yuan-temple figure, so the local p107 title surface fits Emperor Yuan / Sima Rui as chapter actor. I retain the existing self-anchor membership. Retrieval still overflows other Yuan/Sima dossiers, so cross-record equivalence stays unresolved; this is not a new merge.

s0778 opens Tao Dan’s genealogy with 父夏，以無行被廢. Immediately after Tao Dan is introduced as 太尉侃之孫, so 夏 here is the disgraced father in that Tao line (Tao Xia), not a bare calendar ‘summer’ or an unrelated Xia surname. No competing dossier was offered. I retain the chapter-local membership for p241 on that reading.

p046’s 武帝踐阼，泰始中 is Western Jin accession language, and p087’s 我已為武帝吏 against 趙王倫篡位 is the same Western Jin Emperor Wu contrasted with the usurping Prince of Zhao. The Beishi anchor writes 晉武帝, which matches that sovereign rather than a Wei or later Wu title. Chapter-local continuity between p046 and restored p087 is already sealed and is not a fresh merge. Overflow still leaves other Wu/Sima dossiers unreviewed, so I keep cross-dossier identity unresolved.

s0129 及宣帝輔政，遷武威太守 sits in Fan Can’s Wei–Jin career before Jin Wudi’s accession, so 宣帝 here is the posthumous Jin temple title for the regent Sima Yi, not a Han Xuan emperor. The jinshu:001 anchor opens with 宣皇帝諱懿, which is that same man. I retain the accepted membership while leaving broader Sima/Xuan dossier overflow unresolved.

p062 appears as 張華領司徒 and later 中書令張華; restored p081 is 中書監張華令陳准奏為上品. Those are the Western Jin minister Zhang Hua’s offices, not a different Zhang with the same graph. The Beishi anchor lists 晉則裴楷、張華 among famous officials, which is the same literary-political Zhang Hua. Chapter-local p062↔p081 continuity stays as previously restored, without authorizing a new merge. Remaining same-name candidates keep cross-dossier equivalence unresolved.

s0019 嵇康又從之遊三年 is Xi Kang studying with Sun Deng in the hermit narrative, which matches the Wei writer Xi Kang rather than a later Ji-clan namesake. I retain p008’s self-membership. Other Xi/Ji Kang dossiers remain possible in principle, so I leave cross-record identity unresolved even without transport overflow.

s0228 後王浚稱制謀僭 is the Youzhou warlord Wang Jun usurping forms of rule and pressuring the recluse, not the Western Jin admiral Wang Jun of the conquest of Wu in a different role-scene. The local actor is that usurping 王浚. Membership stays on p084; overflow among Wang Jun dossiers keeps equivalence unresolved.
